name: Touhou: Protest in Perspective
source:
An immortal switches bodies with someone fated to die soon. 

When Akyuu switches bodies with Mokou, they're confronted with a choice: switch back, or stay. Help Akyuu discover what she truly wants... Or needs.

[from [url=https://megapig9001.itch.io/touhou-protest-in-perspective]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个不朽的人与一个注定要死的人交换了身体。

当Akyuu与Mokou互换身体时，他们面临着一个选择：变回去，还是留下来。帮助Akyuu发现她真正想要什么……或需要什么。

[来自[url=https://megapig9001.itch.io/touhou-protest-in-perspective]itch.io[/url]]
